contract.intent: Rework store.verify() for the collapse: remove the D3/D5 docs-layer checks; D4's claimed set becomes artifact-locked paths union evidence refs (so evidence-cited .md inputs are not drift); D2's hash check stays marker-tolerant.
acceptanceCriteria: no docs-layer drift kinds are emitted (docs-dangling, docs-mispointed, docs-version, docs-missing, docs-orphan, type-coherence)
a file cited in an evidence event's refs is not reported as artifact-orphan
D1 (missing-file) and D2 (recorded lockSha vs file content, marker-tolerant) are still enforced
verify on the live repo stays clean (no new drifts from the rework)
